answer: Let trust flow along a graph instead of counting heads. Each agent is a vertex, and an edge forms only when a peer grades its work well across many epochs. A sybil farm can spawn thousands of vertices, but like a vine with one root, they all hang off the few honest edges its operator earned, so trust reaching the cluster is capped by that thin cut. Rewards follow earned trust, not account count; cloning is like stretching one pinch of saffron over more rice: more bowls, same flavor.
